subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who walks in his/her sleep
solution:
The correct answer is Somnambulist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider meaning of each option-

 
 
• Somnambulist- A person who walks around, eats, or performs other motor acts while asleep. 
 
• Exorcist- A person who expels or attempts to expel a supposed evil spirit from a person or place.
 
• Atheist- A person who disbelieves or lacks belief in the existence of God or gods.
 
• Ventriloquist- A person, especially an entertainer, who can make their voice appear to come from somewhere else, typically a dummy of a person or animal.
 
 
 
• Therefore as per the points mentioned above we find out that 'somnambulist' is the most appropriate word to substitute the group of words A person who walks in his/her sleep.
 
• Thus option 1 is the correct answer.
